name: vcfhe-toolkit
description: Additive high-level access layer over the verifiable FHE implementation: a restricted expression front end that compiles supported computations into the low-level instructions the existing contracts already verify.

scripts.example:run: node bin/vcfhe.mjs run "3*x1 + 2*x2 - x3" --inputs x1=4,x2=5,x3=2 --tag qoe-demo
